mapper.sql: id, risk_code, category, risk_name, risk_description, inherent_likelihood, inherent_impact, inherent_score, inherent_risk, residual_likelihood, residual_impact, residual_score, residual_risk, risk_owner, dept, status, related_process, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM itgc_risk WHERE risk_code = #{riskCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itgc_risk ( risk_code, category, risk_name, risk_description, inherent_likelihood, inherent_impact, residual_likelihood, residual_impact, risk_owner, dept, status, related_process, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{riskCode}, #{category}, #{riskName}, #{riskDescription}, #{inherentLikelihood}, #{inherentImpact}, #{residualLikelihood}, #{residualImpact}, #{riskOwner}, #{dept}, #{status}, #{relatedProcess}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE itgc_risk SET category = #{category}, risk_name = #{riskName}, risk_description = #{riskDescription}, inherent_likelihood = #{inherentLikelihood}, inherent_impact = #{inherentImpact}, residual_likelihood = #{residualLikelihood}, residual_impact = #{residualImpact}, risk_owner = #{riskOwner}, dept = #{dept}, status = #{status}, related_process = #{relatedProcess}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM itgc_risk WHERE inherent_risk = #{inherentRisk}

SELECT FROM itgc_risk
inherent_likelihood IS NOT NULL AND inherent_impact IS NOT NULL
residual_likelihood IS NOT NULL AND residual_impact IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY inherent_score DESC

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN inherent_risk = '심각' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical, SUM(CASE WHEN inherent_risk = '높음' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high, SUM(CASE WHEN inherent_risk = '중간' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium, SUM(CASE WHEN inherent_risk = '낮음' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low, SUM(CASE WHEN inherent_risk = '미미' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minimal FROM itgc_risk GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
